name: Grand Hyatt San Francisco
positioning: Downtown high-rise hotel on Union Square with floor-to-ceiling windows and bay, city or Union Square views
best_for: Travelers who want a Union Square base for exploring San Francisco
Guests who want high-floor suites with bay or city views

facts.text: Grand Hyatt San Francisco is a downtown high-rise hotel on Union Square.
The hotel is minutes from Chinatown, Golden Gate Theatre and Hayes Valley.
Floor-to-ceiling windows in each room look out on Union Square, the bay or the city.
Bay View rooms are on the 19th floor or higher.
Suites have a separate living area and hardwood floors.
The Deluxe Suite on the 33rd floor has a large wet bar and San Francisco Bay views.
From the 22nd floor, the Bayview Residence looks over San Francisco Bay and the Financial District.
The concierge desk has a map of scenic jogging routes.
OneUP Restaurant serves a buffet breakfast of American classics.
OneUP Lounge, on the Mezzanine Level, serves wines, cocktails and savory bites.

highlights.text: The Luxury Suite on the 34th floor has a kitchenette, a sauna, a soaking tub and floor-to-ceiling city views.
The Bayview Residence is a two-bedroom apartment with a full kitchen.
The 35th-floor fitness center has floor-to-ceiling windows with sweeping views of the city.
The hotel's wedding venues include a top-floor reception area with panoramic views of San Francisco Bay.
Club Access rooms include the Grand Club lounge, which serves free breakfast and snacks.

considerations.text: Self-parking is in the Sutter-Stockton Garage at 444 Stockton Street, not at the hotel.
Guests bringing a dog must tell the hotel at least three days before arrival.
WhataHotel notes a busy downtown location with urban noise.
